description: Create, destroy, and modify ZFS zpools and their vdev layouts, pool properties, and filesystem properties.

parameters.name: disable_new_features
parameters.description: If true, disable new ZFS feature flags when creating. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: filesystem_properties
parameters.description: Dictionary of ZFS filesystem properties to set on the root dataset (for example compression, dedup). Default: {}

parameters.name: force
parameters.description: If true, force operations (for example overwrite existing devices). Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: mountpoint
parameters.description: Filesystem mountpoint for the root dataset.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name of the zpool to manage.

parameters.name: pool_properties
parameters.description: Dictionary of ZFS pool properties to set (for example autoexpand, cachefile). Default: {}

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Whether the pool should exist. Choices: "present" ← (default) "absent"

parameters.name: temp_name
parameters.description: Temporary name used during pool creation.

parameters.name: vdevs
parameters.description: List of vdev definitions for the pool.

examples:
- name: Create pool "tank" on /dev/sda
  community.general.zpool:
    name: tank
    vdevs:
      - disks:
          - /dev/sda

- name: Create mirrored pool "tank"
  community.general.zpool:
    name: tank
    vdevs:
      - type: mirror
        disks:
          - /dev/sda
          - /dev/sdb

- name: Add a cache device to tank
  community.general.zpool:
    name: tank
    vdevs:
      - disks:
          - /dev/sda
      - role: cache
        disks:
          - /dev/nvme0n1

- name: Set pool and filesystem properties
  community.general.zpool:
    name: tank
    ashift: 12
    compression: lz4
    vdevs:
      - disks:
          - /dev/sda

- name: Destroy pool "tank"
  community.general.zpool:
    name: tank
    state: absent
